_about: Retries of objects the 3D step could not handle (no glow, no glass, no thin loops: solid shapes only) and environment pieces for the sandbox. Same fragments as v0.

subjects.subject: A small round wooden buckler shield seen straight from the front, thick solid planks painted leaf green with a cream ring, a solid domed iron boss in the middle, iron rim with big rivets, matte, no reflections.
A small hand axe standing perfectly upright, head at the top: a short straight thick wooden handle and one chunky wedge-shaped steel blade on one side, simple solid shapes, matte.

A wizard's staff standing perfectly upright, a thick straight pale wooden pole, at the top three short thick wooden prongs gripping a solid opaque amber stone ball, a green cloth band below it, chunky solid shapes, no glow, no transparency.
An unlit wooden torch standing perfectly upright, a thick wooden stick whose top is a fat bundle of dark tarred cloth bound with two iron bands, no flame, solid chunky shapes, matte.

A short thick magic wand standing perfectly upright, carved from pale wood with a spiral groove, wide leather-wrapped grip at the bottom, a solid opaque amber stone knob at the top, chunky proportions like a small club, no glow.
A small lantern standing on a flat base, a solid iron frame with four opaque warm amber panels, a pointed iron roof with a ring handle on top, chunky solid shapes, no glow, no transparency.

A small round creature like a smooth chestnut-brown ball with about twelve big fat blunt cream cone spikes spaced apart, two stubby feet, two round angry white eyes, simple solid toy-like shapes, no fur, no fine detail.

A small wayside shrine: a waist-high thick-walled pale cream stone egg with a large round opening in the front showing a solid green moss cushion inside, standing on a flat ring of grey stones, chunky solid shapes, no glow.
A small squat potion bottle of solid opaque mint-green ceramic with a fat cork and a brown string tied around the neck, chunky toy-like shape, matte, no transparency, no glass.
A single large rounded grey boulder with a few flat facets and a patch of green moss on top, chunky simple shape.
A cluster of three chunky grey rocks of different sizes sitting together, moss and two small flowers on top, simple solid shapes.
A wide old tree stump with thick spreading roots, flat cut top showing rings, brown bark, a patch of moss, chunky solid shapes.
A round bush drawn as one solid smooth green blob made of a few big rounded lumps, with a few tiny pink flowers, like a sculpted clay bush, no separate leaves.
A stylised tree with a short thick brown trunk and a canopy made of three big smooth solid green rounded lumps like scoops of clay, no separate leaves, no gaps, toy-like.
A free-standing stone archway gate made of big chunky grey blocks with a keystone, thick pillars, moss on top, wide enough to walk through, solid simple shapes.
An unlit campfire: a ring of chunky grey stones around a small pyramid of thick brown logs, no flames, solid simple shapes.
A small adventurer's tent of thick cream canvas with a green stripe, a simple solid triangular prism shape with a closed front flap, wooden pegs, no ropes.
A tall wooden pole on a heavy stone base carrying a thick stiff cream banner with a large green tree emblem, the banner hangs flat like a board, solid simple shapes.
